title: OfficeCLI Skills hero image
command: officecli new img "OfficeCLI Skills hero image" --prompt-file ./prompt.md --ratio landscape --no-publish
verification: preview image exists and is a valid PNG
notes: Checked-in image is a deterministic documentation fixture so the public repo can be validated without a private image-generation key.
Use the command above with configured external or hosted image generation to reproduce a live generated image.
